property_summary: For any admissible deposit (any actor, any amount), the onlyOwner guard is purely an access check: after one fallback deposit, a successful owner-only withdrawAll must leave depositsCount equal to the number of deposits (1); the mutant's guard increments it on guarded calls, making depositsCount 2.
change_summary: Insert a depositsCount increment inside the onlyOwner modifier so guarded calls also bump the counter.
